listing.name: Onslaught Sleek + Other Onslaughts
listing.summary: A mod made by me and <@142370041839484928> ,with the sprite provided by <@312119593089105921> we present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a rare prototype Hegemony Onslaught ship and several bounty ships to merc fleets and markets.

description: Introduces the Onslaught Sleek, a prototype warship that appears rarely in mercenary fleets and markets. It also adds unique bounty ships with custom portraits that roam the sector, which players can fight and capture.

discordPostHtml:
A mod made by me and ,with the sprite provided by
we present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!
but beware the mercs wernt he only ones to get ahold of this prototype....face a terrifying bounty fleet and claim it for yourself? or let it roam causing chaos to pathers mercs and explorers alike!

Version 1.2 Update: Fixed Crash issue involving the stabilized shield emitter thanks to KWHWWYMWN on the Starsector discord! Version 1.2 IS save compatible we fixed it
Version 1.3 Update: More balancing better descriptions named manufacturer changed system of bounty ship to better reflect its uniqueness IS save compatible
Version 1.4 Update: Even more balancing bounty's have their own custom portraits NEW BOUNTY SHIP TO FIGHT AND OBTAIN still save compatible
Version 1.5 Update: Ship polygons have been edited to look nicer and added 4 new bounties to the sector so go out there and end their chaos and claim em for your own! NOTE VERSION 1.5 IS NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE WITH VERSIONS 1.0 THROUGH 1.4 I AM SORRY I NEEDED TO ORGANIZE THE FILE NAMES

gallery.aiCaption: A collage of four screenshots showing large white warships firing volleys of missiles in space.

A screenshot showing the rear view of a white ship at the top of the screen against a dark nebula background.
A vertical screenshot of two ships firing at each other with text reading 'meat?......flesh!....FLESH GIVE US YOUR FLESH!!!!!!'
